items.title: Tim Ries interviewed by Monk Rowe, Utica, New York, March 19, 2022
items.q: Andy Snitzer, the saxophone player who left the Stones to go with Paul Simon.

ctx.x: We might as well talk about the Stones a little bit as long as we’re here. When you got the call or whatever to join, was there any question of whether you would or not?

Well weirdly enough when I got the call it was my friends who live in New York who had played in the horn section with the Stones, Mike Davis on trombone, Kent Smith on trumpet, and Andy Snitzer, the saxophone player who left the Stones to go with Paul Simon. So he was leaving, they needed a guy who played sax, piano, organ, which I can do that stuff. So when Andy was leaving they got together and decided that a few of the musicians that they knew who could be best suited for that, and they called me. It was like…
Were there written horn parts for you?
